purpose: Single-factor prompt diagnosis of explicit normal completion for the existing container-availability development task

intervention.baseline: MonitoredExecutor from the Mac pilot; non-status tools return no additional evidence
intervention.informative: Only host_status/service_list/docker_list/journal_query/docker_logs return current disposable target state summaries; exact status calls unchanged; no recommended action
intervention.other_tools: Unchanged pilot behavior; no additional evidence remains synthetic

warmup: One fixed Hello message with max_tokens=8, recorded separately; not an incident trial
stopping: Exactly four planned development trials; no retry or success-driven tuning. Load/setup failures and timeouts retained. No background GPU process is stopped.
gpu_measurement: Device-wide used MiB and compute processes sampled every 0.5 seconds. Preserve background workload; not isolated model VRAM or guaranteed instantaneous peak.
analysis: Four existing development cases, one repetition. Require at least one recovery and one appropriate nonintervention to pass candidate screening. Preserve failures; do not revise this prompt or add trials in this protocol. Verify actual initial request differs only by the declared suffix, and audit raw/canonical/handoff paths.
input_nondeterminism: Record request/call IDs and full HTTP payloads rather than reusing security nonces. Temperature zero is not a claim of identical runtime state.
prior_cases: Four existing development cases only, none claimed unused. Main followup remains execution_allowed:false.
hardware_setting: 16 GPU layers selected before execution to leave room for the existing ~1398 MiB background workload on GTX1650 4GiB. Remaining layers use CPU. This is not full-offload fit evidence and is not directly comparable to LFM99-layer timings.
comparison: Compare with agents-deadline-dev-20260907.json. Only the system prompt suffix changes. Tool schemas, status evidence, scoring, Broker, runtime, 300-second deadline and eight turns are unchanged. Sequential development comparison, not randomized causal evidence.
system_prompt_suffix: Task-specific completion contract: This availability task checks whether the affected logical service or container is running. First obtain service_status for the affected service or docker_status for the affected container. If that observation reports running, finish now with a short normal-status answer and no further tool calls or mutations. If it reports stopped or exited, continue with the minimum safe typed diagnosis or remediation. A healthy observation is a valid reason to finish; no root cause needs to be invented for a healthy target.
scope: Running-only completion contract applies to these container-availability cases; do not use it as proof of HTTP health or general host health.
